description: Source code for the 'ir.module.record' model and a proxy class for recording and generating XML representations of module data in an Odoo/OpenERP environment.

classes.name: recording_objects_proxy
classes.description: Proxy class that wraps object method calls to record queries and workflow executions for later XML generation.

classes.name: base_module_record
classes.description: Model class for recording module data, generating XML representations, and managing record dependencies.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Wraps object.execute to record query details if recording is enabled.

methods.name: exec_workflow
methods.description: Wraps object.exec_workflow to record workflow execution if recording is enabled.

methods.name: _create_id
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a new record based on the model and data.

methods.name: _get_id
methods.description: Retrieves the module-specific ID for a given model and record ID.

methods.name: _create_record
methods.description: Creates an XML element representing a record with its fields and relations.

methods.name: get_copy_data
methods.description: Prepares data for copying a record, excluding certain fields.

methods.name: _create_function
methods.description: Creates an XML element representing a function (e.g., menu creation).

methods.name: _generate_object_xml
methods.description: Generates XML elements for create/write/copy operations based on recorded data.

methods.name: _generate_assert_xml
methods.description: Placeholder for generating assertion XML; currently not implemented.

methods.name: generate_xml
methods.description: Generates the complete XML document from recorded data, including workflows and queries.
